patterns.problem: Queries that are not scoped to the signed-in farm are found again in each review round, so harvest log and cider orders need a third changes review and farm shop stock a second.
patterns.fix: The project's docs state that every query on farm-owned data goes through the farm-scoped query helper, and a project test fails on any unscoped query of farm-owned tables.

patterns.problem: Tasks that touch field tablet data finish with an open finding that offline edits overwrite newer ones on sync, because the project has no rule for offline sync conflicts.
patterns.fix: Decide and record the project's offline sync conflict rule in its docs, then implement it once in the tablet sync layer and close the open findings against it.

patterns.problem: Overnight resumes fail because the project's nightly cleanup job deletes the development database kept in the tmp folder, in three tasks.
patterns.fix: Move the development database out of the tmp folder, or exclude it from the project's nightly cleanup job.

patterns.problem: Reports do not say whether the farm shop till or the field tablets already have the change, so the operator writes after the report to ask.
patterns.fix: The owner instructions' report section asks for whether the change is live on each device and any step the operator must take, such as pressing update on the till.
